name: Major floods
summary: No GDACS orange or red flood alerts; local flooding from Cyclone Murasu
state: GDACS listed no orange or red flood alerts on 3 Nov. Cyclone Murasu caused localised flooding in low-lying parts of Prakasam district, where 198mm of rain fell in the 24 hours to 06:00 on 3 Nov (NationPath); no flood deaths had been reported.
for_you: Follow local authority warnings in coastal Andhra Pradesh.
why: Floods affect more people than any other hazard, displacing millions each year.
drivers: Extreme rainfall, monsoons, cyclones, snowmelt, dam failures.

rubric.alert: GDACS red flood alert, or > 100 deaths in a single event.
rubric.watch: GDACS orange flood alert, or a flood displacing > 50,000.
